messages.content: 你能告訴我克里斯蒂亞諾·羅納度在英超聯賽的曼聯俱樂部的歷史進球數，然後將其與曼聯在同一聯賽中的最佳射手進行比較，最後告訴我誰是2019-2020賽季英超聯賽的最佳射手嗎？

function.name: team_stats_get_top_scorer
function.description: Fetch the top scorer of a specified football team. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning:
The user asks:

"Can you tell me Cristiano Ronaldo's total goal count at Manchester United in Premier League? Then compare it with Manchester United's best striker in same league. Finally tell who was the Premier League top scorer in 2019-2020 season."

We need data.

First part: Cristiano Ronaldo never played for Manchester United; he played for Sporting CP, Manchester United from 2003–2009, then Real Madrid etc. He did play for Man Utd but only until 2009. But question says "in English Premier League". Actually Ronaldo didn't score many goals for Man Utd in EPL because he left before they joined? Wait timeline: Ronaldo signed for Man Utd in 2003 and stayed till 2009. During his time, he scored some goals in Premier League. We can find number: According to records, Ronaldo scored 42 Premier League goals for Manchester United between 2003-09. Let's verify: I recall he had 42 PL goals. Yes.

Second part: Compare with Manchester United's best striker in same league. That would refer to their current or historical record holder? Likely refers to club's all-time leading Premier League scorer: Wayne Rooney holds record with 53 Premier League goals for Man Utd. So we should say Rooney > Ronaldo.

Third part: Who was the Premier League top scorer in 2019-20 season? It was Harry Kane with 26 goals.

Thus answer accordingly.

But maybe ask about "best striker" meaning highest scoring player currently playing for Man Utd? At present (as of 2026) it's Marcus Rashford? Or Erling Haaland? In 2019-20 season, top scorer for Man Utd was Marcus Rashford with 12? Actually Rashford scored 13 Premier League goals in 2018-19, 10 in 2019-20. But better might be "Manchester United's best striker" historically: Wayne Rooney indeed.

So provide comparison: Ronaldo 42 vs Rooney 53.

Also mention difference.

Let's produce Chinese response as requested presumably in Traditional Chinese.

We'll use tool calls? There's no direct function needed except retrieving stats. Could call functions to get accurate numbers. Use team_stats_get_top_scorer for Manchester United? Might give top scorer. For Ronaldo's goals, could use player_stats_get_all_time_goals specifying competition Premier League. We'll do two calls.

Call player_stats_get_all_time_goals(team=ManUtd, player=Cristiano Ronaldo, competition='Premier League'). Also call team_stats_get_top_scorer(TeamName="Manchester United") returns top scorer likely Wayne Rooney.

Then also call league_stats_get_top_scorer('English Premier League', season='2019-2020').

Proceed.
